Homepage

Hello! My name is Yu Shi (时雨). I am an assistant professor in Business Analytics. My research interests include Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) and optimization modeling for benchmarking and performance/efficiency/productivity evaluation. You can find the most up-to-date list of my publications on my Google Scholar Profile.

Education

Ph.D., the Business School, Worcester Polytechnic Institute
MFin, Smith School of Business, Queen’s University
BCom, Rotman School of Management, University of Toronto
